description: Safely create, update, validate, preview and publish/schedule Progressive CMS content through public machine contracts (REST/MCP/CLI/.pcpub). Discovery-first; CLI for long deterministic workflows; .pcpub artifact mode for bulk/offline authoring; no direct DB; no Core patches.
entry_workflow: agent bootstrap (site, environment, actor, contracts, capabilities, skills)
verify actor/scopes; stop before any action whose scope is missing
skill compatibility check against reported contracts
artifact refs by path: require capabilities.pcpub.external_entries.supported and pcpub_versions containing 2; otherwise use existing discovery/UUID workflow
fetch only the required block schemas
media acquisition discovery (providers; stock search/import, opt-in generation)
external research (skill: progressive-cms-web-research) — search, select 3-8 sources, fetch with --out, keep provenance
build draft payload (IDs only, no paths/URLs)
add to ChangeSet / submit Publication Bundle (stable idempotency key)
schedule/publish only with explicit scope and task permission
